comments.author: Jennacide
comments.body_html: Alrighty, I’ve done some testing on 3.7.1 and it works on there, so I believe you have installed incorrectly, I even asked The Magic 8 Ball and it said “Signs point to Yes” so let me give you a bit of common practice when it comes to mods, Lots of mods come as a drag and drop system (some do not) I have it setup where you open the RAR file and drag and drop the “user” folder into your main install of SPT. Typically if you open the file and find a user folder it’s safe to just drop it in the main directory.
